intro: The Palestinian economy is small and depends heavily on aid, farming and jobs in Israel, with restrictions on movement and trade.

chapters.title: Work and trade
text: Olives and olive oil, stone quarrying, farming and small factories are important. Many Palestinians have worked in Israel or its settlements. Israel collects many taxes on the Palestinian Authority's behalf.
Gaza's economy has been under a blockade since 2007, and the war has destroyed most of it.

chapters.title: Aid
text: International aid pays for much of the budget, schools and health care.

keyTerms.meaning: Restricting goods and people going in or out of an area.

cardGroups.title: Made in Palestine
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Palestine makes and sells to the world.
